jobText:
Job ID JR120349 Meet the team: Dexcom is a high-growth, fast-paced environment where you work with a leading-edge data platform test team to contribute to the full life cycle of software in a fast-growing organization. You will work alongside highly skilled and passionate test engineering professionals who know how to deliver exceptional results while also having some fun along the way. For this role, you would be joining Dexcom's Software R&D, Data Platform Test Engineering team.

Where you come in:
- You will participate in building quality into products by writing automated tests and performing tests including ad hoc testing throughout the development cycle.
- You will participate in the development of software requirements and design specification.
- You will design, develop, execute, and maintain automated and manual test scripts to test the functionalities of the Dexcom CGM software, and system.
- You will create verification and validation test plans, test reports, traceability matrices and review with relevant stakeholders.
- You will record and track issues in the bug tracking system.
- You will analyze failures and collaborate with development teams to ensure root cause is investigated.
- You will contribute to release process improvements.

What makes you successful:
- You will have 1-2 years of hands-on experience in software development or software test development using Python or other OOP languages.
- Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
- You will have experience with automated test development in API testing.
- You will have experience working within a wide variety of automated testing frameworks, including Robot framework.
- Your strong understanding of API Testing, microservices, and distributed systems in cloud environments.
- Your experience working with automated UI testing.
- Your experience working in Cloud Applications like Google Cloud or AWS.
- Your experience with containerization tools like Docker, Kubernetes.
- Medical device industry, experience working with FDA design control process highly desired.
- Knowledge of GCP with Airflow, Dataflow, BigQuery is a plus.
- Knowledge of distributed event streaming platforms like Kafka is a plus.
- Experience with performance testing is a plus.
- You will bring CI/CD experience, especially using cloud-based technologies.
- You must have five or more years of Agile development and test development experience.
- The ability to work cross functionally to collaborate with software development teams for the testing, deployment, and reporting on product performance, quality, security, and stability.
- You must be a self-starter and able to work with minimal guidance with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

What you'll get:
- A front row seat to life changing CGM technology.
- A full and comprehensive benefits program.
- Growth opportunities on a global scale.
- Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
- An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required: 15-25%

Experience and Education Requirements: Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 0-2 years related experience.

Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.
